A Gold Clio for Aljoša on the Brain Train, an AI hybrid documentary animated entirely with Kling AI.

A proud milestone for AI-powered storytelling. Congratulations to the entire team! 🏆 🙌@davincisdigital #KlingAI

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Kling AI megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Digital da Vincis (@davincisdigital); megjelent: 2026-11-20T13:56:12+00:00; link: https://x.com/davincisdigital/status/2123777430749893093; média: videó, 13 másodperc]
🏆 GOLD for Slovenia 🇸🇮 in Hollywood!

We are incredibly stunned and proud to announce that our AI hybrid documentary "Aljoša on the brain train" has won a Gold Clio at the 2026 Entertainment Awards by @The_Clios alongside major studios and streaming platforms such as Netflix, Warner Bros., Prime Video, HBO, and pretty much any major studio or streaming platform you could think of!

The ceremony happened tonight at the very heart of Hollywood - at the Dolby Theater, the home of the Oscars!

Surreal to see AI projects getting recognised alongside such major Hollywood productions as The Odyssey by Christopher Nolan, Stranger Things, Backrooms, Dune and Jaimee Lee Curtis, who received an Honorary Award!

Congrats to our partners, and thanks to everyone who supported the film and made this possible @ARTEfr  VOYO Slovenia, PRO PLUS, Modri Junaki and many others!

The film was entirely animated with @Kling_ai, voice over created with @ElevenLabs, and other AI tools such as @magnific @invideoOfficial @suno were used in the process!
